scope: Original open cubic graph, right-field SU(2) convention, gauge-invariant three-plaquette trace function, all endpoint transport signs, connection term, boundary degrees and complete row defect. This test function is not the actual Yang–Mills ground logarithm; only the universal gauge identity is tested. Flat and nonflat full graph pseudoinverses, their gauge zero modes, full row remainders and exact vertical norm loss are checked. Actual-ground root checks are algebra diagnostics after the written SG substitution.
